<summary>💅带王冠的新盔甲💅</summary>

## 甚至兼容盔甲纹饰！！

![带纹饰的所有盔甲并列展示](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/5391305e35c64f7bd8c16b05cc5653d1a7c716d8.png)

</details>

<details>
<summary>🥕进食动画!!!🥕[1.21.4+]</summary>

![食物及其动画效果](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/o962rBDR/images/1f7ab4d15103c2c2f758ccf37d72e2d5593ec192.gif)

</details>

<details>
<summary>⚔️物品⚔️</summary>

- [新的钻石和下界合金工具](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/38b0b73f4dc13427cccc61812cc48c116ea47160.png)
- 更暗的下界合金
- 新的三叉戟
- 更暗的桶（制作中）
- 来自[VanillaTweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)的2D床

</details>

<details>
<summary>👀无干扰设计👀</summary>

- 无鱼漂
- [更低的盾牌](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/ba3bfd3e45aeb48e7aea4fc05177f78a2aee88a0.png)
- [更低的火焰](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/ba3bfd3e45aeb48e7aea4fc05177f78a2aee88a0.png)
- [更小的图腾（1.21.4+版本中，图腾仅在副手持有时变小）](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/d506b6a37ba2d645fdc55a737228df44a519b37c.png)
- 无暗角效果
- 无南瓜头盔遮罩
- 来自[VanillaTweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)的无干扰附魔光效
- 无横扫和暴击粒子效果

</details>

<details>
<summary>🩷粉色受伤倾斜效果🩷</summary>

![史蒂夫正在受到伤害](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iQx2ijVe/images/77f7580c754dfc9dbe88d1ddb7d86ae7b56eab62.png)

</details>
